set.name: glow_mod
set.description: A small fictional Fabric mod (examples/glow_mod): Java code, a data pack (functions, recipe, loot table), assets (item models, en_us / tr_tr translations), a YAML config copied out of the jar, a client payload, a game test, a byte-identical copy of one function under datapack/, and a reference tree (reference/original-plugin, the Paper plugin it was ported from) declared as index.reference. 14 questions, 7 Turkish and 7 English: callers x3, cross_layer x2, config x2, resources x2, flow, behaviour x2, where x2 (one of them explicitly about the original plugin).
set.gold_verified_by: Gold facts were written by reading every file of examples/glow_mod line by line; every source.at line was re-read by hand after the example was finished, and each fact's source.at/source.contains pair is re-checked against the benchmark copy before any approach is scored (metrics.validate_gold).

provenance.questions_written_by: an agent asked by the Verinoda maintainer to write examples/glow_mod and this set in one session; it did not run Verinoda on the example and saw no Verinoda output for these questions
provenance.gold_written_by: same agent, by reading every file of examples/glow_mod; checked with metrics.validate_gold only
provenance.example_written_by: same agent, same session, before the questions
provenance.caveat: held out for Verinoda's retrieval on these questions (no Verinoda run and no Verinoda output while writing them), but not independent of the design: the Minecraft support (resource ids, data-pack linking, reference trees, class-qualified Java calls, Turkish passive caller questions) was developed against a similar private mod by the same project, and this example was written afterwards by an agent that knew which of those features it should exercise

verinoda_analyze.budget: config defaults (60 s, 40 tool calls, 6000 tokens)

llm.status: not measured: llm='none' (use --llm anthropic with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set)

raw.note: no index; every query greps and reads the working tree

verinoda.what: workflow.scan = Graphify-derived AST index (in-process) + snapshot (file hashes) + stale-claim check; warm = same tree again with the AST cache present
